title: A fix-check reviewer spawns only after `merge --fix-check` renders the record it will fill
why: A lane spent a fix-check reviewer that the merge tool would not record, because a chain takes one fix check (lane fix-push-needs-fail-record, via the coordinator 20:33 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 20:34 CST. The lane routine, or a guard on the spawn, runs `merge --fix-check` first; a refusal there stops the spawn. Related: steps fix-check-chain, fix-base-own-round-head. Lane session_013NEJL1MAU4nrqwiN3pHJzz (coordinator 20:35 CST Nov 8). PR #2392, head a29ba5418 (23:34 CST Nov 8); a29ba5418 also fixes the missing events.json in the mutant tree.
